aboutText: Based in Brooklyn, L&C Harding Plumbing has been delivering reliable commercial, industrial and domestic plumbing services across Melbourne's western suburbs for years. From backflow testing to sheet metal fabrication, our skilled team covers Brooklyn, Footscray, Sunshine, Newport and beyond. We combine genuine expertise with honest pricing to keep your property running smoothly, day in and day out.
servicesText: L&C Harding Plumbing handles everything from urgent leak repairs to large-scale industrial fitouts. Our Brooklyn team delivers roofing installation, asbestos removal, carpentry maintenance and precision sheet metal fabrication across Melbourne's west.

services.title: Commercial Plumbing
services.desc: Complete plumbing solutions for shops, offices and commercial properties across Brooklyn and Melbourne's west.

services.desc: Heavy-duty plumbing services designed for factories, warehouses and industrial facilities throughout the western suburbs.

reviews.text: L&C Harding handled the full roof replacement at our Brooklyn warehouse. Professional from start to finish, on time and on budget. Couldn't recommend them more highly to any local business.

reviews.text: We called L&C Harding for an urgent backflow test at our Footscray property. They arrived the same day and sorted everything out quickly. Honest pricing and genuinely friendly tradies.
reviews.name: Sarah Thornton

reviews.text: L&C Harding Plumbing fixed a major leak at our Brooklyn home and also handled some carpentry maintenance. Their team was punctual, tidy and the quality of work was excellent. Highly recommend.
